posts.text: With finals season coming up and more and more students flooding campus to study, finding a spot becomes a challenge. People are lining up at Weldon at 8am, and seats are taken before you can even get there, leading to lots of precious time wasted. I’m excited to share SpotUWO! SpotUWO is a live web app that provides crowd-sourced, real-time updates on study spot availability across campus.
